final: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(s.record_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(s.record_count - a.mean_count) AS average_excess FROM side_counts AS s CROSS JOIN average_count AS a WHERE s.record_count > a.mean_count
